description: This file implements the core business logic for managing loan accounts in the Fineract platform. It includes operations such as making repayments, refunds, disbursing loans, foreclosures, and updating collateral and delinquency states. It interacts heavily with other services, repositories, and event publishers to coordinate the state and behavior of loan objects.

classes.name: LoanAccountDomainServiceJpa
classes.description: Service class implementing core loan account operations such as repayments, refunds, disbursements, foreclosures, and collateral updates, within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: makeRepayment
methods.description: Processes a loan repayment transaction, validates the transaction, updates schedules, triggers events, and manages related post-processing such as journal entries and notification.

methods.name: updateLoanCollateralStatus
methods.description: Updates the release status of collateral associated with a set of loan collateral management objects.

methods.name: createInterestRefundLoanTransaction
methods.description: Creates a loan transaction representing an interest refund, based on interest calculations and service lookups.

methods.name: createManualInterestRefundWithAmount
methods.description: Manually creates an interest refund transaction for a loan, given a target transaction and refund amount.

methods.name: makeChargePayment
methods.description: Processes payment towards a specific loan charge, validating date, account status, and transaction rules; updates balances and records events.

methods.name: handlePayDisbursementTransaction
methods.description: Handles the specific logic for disbursing funds linked to a loan, including marking charges as paid.

methods.name: checkClientOrGroupActive
methods.description: Ensures that associated client or group accounts are active before transactions are processed.

methods.name: makeRefund
methods.description: Processes a general loan refund, validates date constraints, records the refund transaction, and triggers relevant events.

methods.name: makeDisburseTransaction
methods.description: Handles loan disbursement transactions, updating loan balances and recording journal entries.

methods.name: reverseTransfer
methods.description: Reverses a given loan transaction if it complies with business rules, notably charge-off timing.

methods.name: setLoanDelinquencyTag
methods.description: Calculates and applies or removes overdue/delinquency tags based on repayment status and due dates.

methods.name: creditBalanceRefund
methods.description: Creates a transaction to refund credit balance, validating date and charge-off status, and notifies relevant systems.

methods.name: makeRefundForActiveLoan
methods.description: Handles refund operations for active loans, including date, account, and event validations.

methods.name: foreCloseLoan
methods.description: Performs foreclosure on a loan, paying off principal, interest, fees, and penalties, updating schedule, and triggering events.

methods.name: disableStandingInstructionsLinkedToClosedLoan
methods.description: Disables any standing instructions associated with a closed loan.

methods.name: updateAndSaveLoanCollateralTransactionsForIndividualAccounts
methods.description: Updates collateral management records related to individual loan accounts.

methods.name: applyInterestRefund
methods.description: Applies an interest refund transaction, associating it with the loan, saving it, and posting relevant journal entries.
